verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, not a software service or app. Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a software or service privacy-settings axis, so it is a category error for a CPU. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself collecting telemetry or offering an opt-out control, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
